facts.fact: The Federal High Court (Justice F.N. Ogazi) examined sections 5(d), 6(c), 44, 45 and 65 of the Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023 in Emmanuel Harunna v. NDPC (FHC/L/CS/1116/2024) and treated the Act as operative; the article gives no judgment date and is dated 28 July 2026.

TechTrends Africa reports the NDPC, led by National Commissioner and CEO Dr Vincent Olatunji, directed unregistered Data Controllers and Processors of Major Importance to register after winning a Federal High Court case; article dated 28 July 2026.
